blurb: Guests can charter private helicopters for travel or scenic tours, learn to fly helicopters, or book aerial photography and film production flights. Services include NYC helicopter tours, luxury travel experiences, and special occasion flights like proposals. Flights depart from NYC heliports and Westchester County Airport.
